actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.make_call.description: Initiate an outbound call using the Telnyx Call Control API.
actions.make_call.props.audio_url.descri: Optional WAV or MP3 URL to play when the call is answered.
actions.make_call.props.connection_id.de: The Telnyx Call Control Application ID (formerly connection ID) used to place the call.
actions.make_call.props.from.description: The caller ID number in E.164 format.
actions.make_call.props.timeout_secs.des: How long to let the destination ring before timing out.
actions.make_call.props.to.description: The destination number or SIP URI.
actions.make_call.props.webhook_url.desc: Optional URL that overrides the default Telnyx webhook destination for this call.
actions.send_sms.description: Send an SMS message using the Telnyx Messages API.
actions.send_sms.props.from.description: The sending number or sender ID.
actions.send_sms.props.to.description: The destination phone number in E.164 format.
description: Telecom API platform for SMS messaging, voice calls, and messaging webhooks.
triggers.message_received.description: Triggers when Telnyx delivers a message.received webhook event.
triggers.message_received.props.webhook_:
To use this trigger, configure your Telnyx messaging webhook manually:

1. Open your Telnyx portal.
2. Go to the messaging profile or inbound messaging configuration you use for SMS.
3. Set the webhook URL to:

```text
{{webhookUrl}}
```

4. Make sure webhook API version is **v2**.
5. Enable or send **message.received** events to this webhook URL.
